spec.studio_prompt: A contemporary low-profile 3-module L-shaped modular sofa measuring 300 cm in width with a 100 cm wide by 300 cm deep chaise at 75 cm overall height. The modules are fully upholstered in heavy textured oatmeal linen (#c6bfb5, #bbb0a2) with softly rounded bullnose edges, seamless cushioned segments, and a concealed dark recessed plinth base (#533f2e). An off-white pleated knit throw with fringe (#d3cdc6) is draped casually over the backrest, accented with square cushions in dusty blush linen and warm ochre velvet (#c28f46).
